name: realms
description: Private Linux desktops for Claude: test GUI apps in a headless labwc realm or an Omarchy VM, and watch them live in a pane

auto_view.title: Show the realm when it starts
auto_view.description: Open the Realm pane the first time the agent starts a desktop in a session

view_mode.title: Live view
view_mode.description: auto draws pixels where the terminal can (Ghostty, kitty) and coloured cells elsewhere

view_fps.title: Live view frames per second
view_fps.description: Frames per second of the Realm pane (1 to 30)

host_guard.title: Guard the host desktop
host_guard.description: While a realm is live, refuse Bash commands that point GUI tools at your own display

full_view.title: Full view opens in
full_view.description: auto uses a Codemux browser pane inside Codemux, your default browser elsewhere

view_cell_aspect.title: Terminal cell shape
view_cell_aspect.description: Height / width of a text cell, so the live view keeps its shape; 0 picks it for your terminal

view_in.title: Watch the realm in
view_in.description: auto: a Codemux browser pane inside Codemux (its terminal shows no pictures), the terminal pane elsewhere
